notes: The author marks the list PRE-TATOOINE ('will undergo changes when it comes out on Wednesday'); posted 27 May 2001 with no Tatooine- or Coruscant-set card. Format set to Premiere - Tatooine per the batch rule; the list itself predates Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting Stuff (7): Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, 'System Indicator', Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Squadron Assignments ('Squassan'), Insurrection and Staging Areas; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
'System Indicator' (the Hidden Base system marker) names no card; kept as posted (UNKNOWN), counted.

Posted 'Squassan' dested Squadron Assignments (common nickname 'Squassin'); 'Insurrection' and 'Staging Areas' are posted as separate cards and dested the separate Endor and Death Star II Effects (the combos came later).

Posted 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay) (the Light Cloud City docking bay); 'Dagobah' dested Dagobah (Light); 'Dagobah Hut' dested Dagobah: Yoda's Hut; 'Tatooine' dested the Premiere Tatooine; 'Tatooine Docking Bay' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94.

Posted 'Capt'n Han' dested Captain Han Solo; 'ANH Wedge (Destiny 4)' dested the A New Hope Wedge Antilles (destiny 4; the strategy contrasts him with his DS2 counterpart); 'Obi with Stick' and 'Luke with Stick' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber and Luke With Lightsaber; 'Leia with Blaster' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando with Axe' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'LSJK' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Coran Horn' and 'Mirax' dested Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik.

Posted 'Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon; 'Artoo in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Red Squad 1' dested Red Squadron 1; 'Signal' dested The Signal; 'A Few Manuvers' dested A Few Maneuvers; 'OOC/TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Savrip' dested Mantellian Savrip; Ounee Ta dested the 2001 Effect, not the Reflections III shield.
The section header says Locations (7) but six are listed; the list totals 60 as published.
The strategy's edit ('Battle Plan instead of I Hope She's All Right') is not applied to the list. The post says the deck went 3-1 in unnamed tournaments.
The note line 'This deck is PRE-TATOOINE...' above the list was parsed as a card and dropped.
